data.description:
Ombre PG in Bangalore (560102) offers a comfortable and hassle-free co-living experience for students and working professionals. The property features fully furnished rooms with essential furniture, attached washrooms, and reliable 24×7 power backup. High-speed WiFi (leased line + backup) ensures seamless work-from-home and online streaming.

Residents have access to a fully equipped kitchen with a microwave, induction plate, fridge, utensils, and cutlery, along with amenities like TV, laundry, housekeeping, lift, and parking facilities. The PG maintains a safe and secure environment with CCTV cameras and an access-controlled entry system.

With a dedicated lounge/sitting area, a clean and organized living environment, and pet-friendly policies with no restrictions, Ombre PG is an excellent choice for those seeking convenience, comfort, and modern living in Bangalore.
